description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-rest-client on top of the
        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the REST Client panel light-up: a @RegisterRestClient proxy is
        registered and called from a test, the BootUI QuarkusRestClientTraceListener SPI hook registers a
        QuarkusRestClientTraceFilter on the proxy, the filter feeds the shared RestClientTraceRecorder, and the
        panel is surfaced on GET /bootui/api/rest-client-trace with working clear and recording-toggle actions.
        Kept separate from bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO
        quarkus-rest-client, so the class-presence gate keeps the REST Client panel unavailable) so
        the present and absent paths are each proven in isolation — the same split used for the
        cache-present/absent and email-present/absent coverage. No Docker is needed; the @RegisterRestClient
        target is the test app's own loopback port.
